# Line-count baseline for .github/scripts/check-file-size-ratchet.sh (crux#20).
#
# Every non-test .go file that was over the 800-line limit when the ratchet
# landed, with its line count at that time. A listed file may not grow past
# its number; an unlisted file may not exceed 800 lines.
#
# Lowering a number (or removing a line once a file is split under 800) is
# always allowed, and the gate prints the exact line to edit. Raising one, or
# adding a new file here, defeats the gate: split the file instead.
#
# The Go code is synced from hivecommons/hive src/crux; splits land there and
# reach this tree through the sync.
1805 agent/manager.go
1010 agent/manager_homes.go
1595 agent/manager_kick.go
